name: en meeting: sprint planning
transcript: Okay, let's go through what we need to settle for the sprint.
First, the login bug. Dana, can you take that one and have a fix by Wednesday?
Sure, I'll have a fix up for review by Wednesday.
Second, we talked about moving to the new design system. I think we should wait until next quarter.
Agreed. We will not migrate this sprint. That's decided.
Third, the demo for the client is on Friday at 2 p.m. Tom, you'll prepare the slides?
Yes, I'll send the slides to everyone by Thursday evening.
What about the performance issue on the dashboard? Does anyone know the cause yet?
Not yet. We're still looking into it. Let's see what the profiler shows.
Also, someone should update the onboarding doc, but I don't think anyone has the time right now.
I can look at it next week if nothing else comes up, but don't count on it.
